verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a guided cap-table import, data validation, or reconciliation workflow for migrating from spreadsheets or other platforms into Carta; all docs relate to the developer API platform (retrieving data, OAuth, MCP plugins) rather than onboarding. The only related community evidence describes onboarding as an 'involved process' with many help articles and fees, and other threads describe difficulty migrating data OUT of Carta — neither confirms an actual guided import/reconciliation feature.
